name: Caxton and CTP Publishers and Printers Limited
source: Caxton and CTP Publishers and Printers Limited reviewed provisional group results for the year ended 30 June 2026, condensed consolidated statement of profit and loss and comprehensive income (SENS 11 September 2026, caxton.co.za). Figures stated in R thousands in the filing and stored here in ZAR. Revenue 6,587,809 less raw materials and consumables used 3,460,135 plus the 5,791 inventory movement equals cost of sales 3,454,344, so gross profit 3,133,465. Operating expenses 2,642,220 are staff costs 1,282,856 plus other operating expenses 1,162,086 plus depreciation and amortisation 255,762 plus impairment of plant 38,254 less the 3,563 reversal of impairment of associate loans less other operating income 93,175, which reconciles to profit from operating activities of 491,245. Net finance costs are stored negative because the group reports net finance income of 252,374. Profit before taxation 748,647 less taxation 169,001 equals profit for the year 579,646, the printed earnings per share of 162.7 cents. The 5,028 income from associates sits between operating profit and profit before taxation and is not one of the panel labels. The FY2025 and older columns are Yahoo Finance aggregations that disagree with the issuer own printed FY2025 comparatives (profit before taxation 770,682 and profit for the year 597,793); only the FY2026 column is taken from the filing.

reconciliation_note: FY2026 bridges, all from the printed statement: Revenue 6,587,809 less Cost of sales 3,454,344 equals Gross profit 3,133,465. Gross profit less Operating expenses 2,642,220 equals Operating profit 491,245. Operating profit 491,245 plus the printed Net finance income of 252,374 (stored as a negative Net Finance Costs) equals 743,619, and the printed Profit before taxation of 748,647 is 5,028 higher because of the group's income from associates, which is not one of the panel labels. Profit before taxation 748,647 less Taxation 169,001 equals Profit for the year 579,646 exactly.
fy2026_column: FY2026 cells on 2026-10-14 match the primary file for the same security; every row is on the same measure as the older cells beside it.
